description: This skill manages autonomous navigation from a given target location to the goal while ensuring collision avoidance. It monitors the robot's progress towards the target and the status of the navigation system. The mission succeeds upon successful navigation completion, otherwise, it remains in progress until a definitive failure or success state is reached.

atomic_propositions.target_received: True when distance_to_target > 100.0. A target location has been set for navigation.
atomic_propositions.path_planned: True when nav_status == 'accepted'. The navigation system has accepted the path plan.
atomic_propositions.moving_towards_target: True when nav_status == 'executing'. The robot is actively executing the planned path.
atomic_propositions.collision_risk: True when min_range < 0.25. An obstacle is detected too close to the robot.
atomic_propositions.target_reached: True when distance_to_target < 0.5. The robot is within close proximity of the target location.
atomic_propositions.navigation_succeeded: True when nav_status == 'succeeded'. The navigation goal was successfully achieved.
atomic_propositions.navigation_failed: True when nav_status in ['aborted', 'canceled']. The navigation process was interrupted or failed.

named_failure_modes.name: collision_imminent
named_failure_modes.description: The robot must never enter a state where an obstacle is too close.

execution_phases.description: The robot receives the target and initiates the path planning process.
The robot moves towards the target while continuously monitoring for obstacles and progress.

terminal_success.description: The mission is accomplished when the navigation status explicitly reports success.

terminal_failure.description: The mission is considered failed if the navigation process is aborted or canceled.
